placements.name: A barely-there haze behind the white page

studies.title: Diffusion
studies.line: One note scatters into thousands of echoes that blur into a cloud: what a reverb does in its first half-second.

variants.name: Echo cloud
variants.line: Crisp points near the source; the further an echo travels, the softer and dimmer it gets, until the points merge into mist.

variants.name: Ink in water
variants.line: Slow folded swirls that thicken and thin, like ink spreading in still water.

studies.title: Waves
studies.line: Sound as rings of pressure moving out through the room, losing their edge as they go.

variants.name: Ripples
variants.line: Rings spread from below the frame and soften with distance; a copy bounced off a wall above crosses them faintly.

variants.name: Contour lines
variants.line: A stack of thin level lines lifted by a slow swell through the middle, like a waveform drawn in relief.

studies.title: Reflections
studies.line: Every echo is the sound bounced off a surface: the early reflections that tell you the size of the space.

variants.name: Mirror room
variants.line: A small light in a room and all its mirror images in the walls, each bounce fainter and softer (the way acousticians model a room).

variants.name: Light on water
variants.line: A faint light low in the sky and its broken reflection: a path of glints that spreads and dims toward you.

studies.title: Shimmer
studies.line: The octave-up sparkle that rises out of a long tail and hangs above it.

variants.name: Rising glints
variants.line: Sparse points that twinkle as they drift upward and thin out toward the top.

variants.name: Caustic veil
variants.line: A soft net of light, like sun on a pool floor, slowly re-knotting itself.

studies.title: Haze
studies.line: The late tail, where the echoes are too dense to hear apart and turn into one soft wash.

variants.name: Moon behind cloud
variants.line: A faint glow, never the moon itself, behind slow cloud, lit at the edges where the cloud thins: the name, pictured.

variants.name: Ground mist
variants.line: Low banks of fog in layers that drift and thin as they rise.

studies.title: Tail and freeze
studies.line: The extra idea: the decay itself, drawn like a spectrogram (time runs left to right, pitch bottom to top), and the freeze that holds it.

variants.name: Warm decay
variants.line: A note strikes at the left edge and its partials stretch out and fade, the high ones first, the low ones last: what “warm” means in a reverb.

variants.name: Freeze
variants.line: The same partials held forever in freeze blue: nothing decays, the field only breathes.
